reason: A read-only DSH security checkup plugin that scans local configuration, plugins, permissions, instruction files, and policy settings, then presents severity-graded reports with an optional local monitoring mode.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供只读安全体检，扫描本地配置、插件、权限和策略并生成分级报告，另含可选的本地运行监控。
summaries.en: Provides read-only security checkups for DeepSeek Harness by scanning local configuration, plugins, permissions, and policies, with graded reports and optional local runtime monitoring.

capabilities: Scans local DSH configuration, plugin metadata, source code, instruction files, and security policy values
Reads credential-file permission metadata and Windows ACL account names without reading credential contents
Optionally monitors outbound request metadata and local file fingerprints in memory
Stores report history, preferences, and baselines in browser localStorage
Can perform a manual read-only GitHub update check
